params.test: Set to true to skip implementation initialization

getRemainingBalanceToRelease().details: This uses internal accounting of the released balance, to avoid recounting CELO that was transferred back to this contract.

params.registryAddress: The address of the registry core smart contract.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params.to: The address to release the amount to.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.registryAddress: The address of a registry contract for routing to other contracts.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

constructor.notice: Sets initialized == true on implementation contracts

getRemainingBalanceToRelease().notice: Returns the remaining balance this contract has left to release.

getVersionNumber().notice: Returns the storage, major, minor, and patch version of the contract.

initialize(address).notice: A constructor for initialising a new instance of a CeloUnreleasedTreasury contract.

release(address,uint256).notice: Releases the Celo to the specified address.

setRegistry(address).notice: Updates the address pointing to a Registry contract.

userdoc.notice: This contract is not allowed to receive transfers of CELO, to avoid miscalculating the epoch rewards and to prevent any malicious actor from routing stolen fund through the epoch reward distribution.
